settings.title: Risk of Plaque & Tartar Buildup
settings.text: Plaque mineralizes into rough tartar within days, trapping harmful microbes. Left unchecked, it creates bad breath and shifts your dog's mouth flora from 'good' to destructive bacteria that irritate gums.

settings.title: Danger of Gum Disease
settings.text: As tartar presses against the gum line, bacteria invade soft tissue, causing painful inflammation and infection. Affected dogs often drool excessively, refuse to eat, and become distressed when chewing.

settings.title: Impact on Your Dog's Health
settings.text: These complications can lead to expensive veterinary procedures (£500-£1,500 per dental cleaning) under risky general anesthesia and reduce your dog's quality of life.

settings.title: Caution: Plaque & Tartar Are Hurting Your Dog!
settings.text: Every day you wait, the bacteria spreads, the pain increases, and the eventual vet bill gets bigger..."

settings.title: Stop silent suffering – protect your dog’s smile

settings.text:
Have you noticed bad breath, plaque, or yellow tartar on your dog’s teeth?

It’s more common than you think – 8 out of 10 dogs have dental problems by the age of 3.

It often starts with plaque, which hardens into tartar and leads to inflammation and pain.

Dogs suffer in silence, and most owners don’t realize it until it’s too late.

We understand the stress of expensive vet visits, anesthesia risks, and feeling helpless.

That’s why we created FreshSmile Kit – a complete dental care solution that lets you remove tartar at home, safely and easily.

settings.title: From bad breath to life-threatening disease

settings.text:
Plaque that isn’t removed hardens into tartar.

Tartar irritates the gums and leads to inflammation and pain.

Bacteria can spread throughout the body, affecting the heart, kidneys, and organs.

In the worst cases, your dog’s life may be shortened.

FreshSmile Kit helps you stop the problem early.

Healthier teeth, happier dog – and peace of mind for you.

settings.title: You may also be interested in:

settings.heading: Is FreshSmile safe for my dog’s teeth and gums?
settings.row_content:
Yes, FreshSmile is designed to be completely safe.

It only activates on hard tooth surfaces – never on the gums – so there’s no risk of injury.

settings.heading: Can I use it on small breeds, puppies, or senior dogs?
settings.row_content:
FreshSmile works for all breeds and sizes.

For puppies, wait until their permanent teeth have come in.

For senior dogs, it’s safe too – just start gently and let them adjust.

settings.heading: Does it hurt my dog
settings.row_content:
No, FreshSmile is completely painless when used correctly.

The gentle sonic vibrations break down plaque and tartar on the surface of the teeth without causing discomfort.

settings.heading: How long does it take to see results?
settings.row_content:
Most owners notice a visible difference after the very first use.

Plaque and tartar start breaking down instantly, and breath smells fresher right away

settings.heading: How often should I use FreshSmile?
settings.row_content:
We recommend 1–2 times per week.

This is enough to keep plaque and tartar under control and support your dog’s long-term dental health.

settings.heading: Does it scratch or damage the enamel?
settings.row_content:
No. FreshSmile uses gentle sonic vibrations that are safe for enamel.

It only works on buildup like tartar and plaque – not on the tooth surface itself.

settings.heading: Can FreshSmile overheat or damage the tooth pulp?
settings.row_content:
No, FreshSmile is not an ultrasonic scaler – it’s a gentle sonic vibration device designed for safe home use.

It only vibrates on the tooth surface and does not generate heat, so there’s no risk of overheating or harming the pulp.

settings.heading: How long does the battery last?
settings.row_content:
One full charge lasts up to 2–3 weeks with normal use.

It also charges quickly with the included USB cable.

settings.heading: What makes FreshSmile different from other dental tools?
settings.row_content:
Unlike cheap copies or harsh ultrasonic scalers, FreshSmile is:

Safe: Activates only on teeth, not gums.

Quiet: Less than 60 dB, so dogs stay calm.

Complete: Comes with all tools you need.

Risk-free: Backed by our 100-day satisfaction guarantee.

settings.heading: Can I really remove tartar at home instead of going to the vet?
settings.row_content:
Yes. FreshSmile is designed so dog owners can safely maintain dental health at home.

For heavy or advanced dental disease, a vet visit may still be needed – but with regular use, FreshSmile helps prevent those expensive visits.

settings.heading: What if my dog is nervous or afraid of the sound?
settings.row_content:
Start slowly and let your dog get used to the gentle vibrations.

Most dogs relax quickly since the device is quiet and non-invasive.

You can also begin with short sessions and increase over time.

settings.heading: What happens if I’m not satisfied with the results?
settings.row_content:
You’re fully covered by our 100-day satisfaction guarantee.

If you don’t see the results you expect, you can return the kit for a full refund – no risk for you.
